## Description

AI safety card for clinicians (what the AI does/doesn't, how to read evidence and flags, never sign without review, how to report an AI incident). Waiting-room poster/notice explaining recording and the right to decline in English, Hindi and Arabic (plus Tamil for pilot). AI incident procedure (report, triage, disable flag, notify, root cause, evaluation set update). Evaluation report from MDV-P3-018.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Safety card and notices reviewed by the clinical advisor and counsel and delivered to pilot clinics.
- [ ] **AC2.** AI incident procedure includes a kill-switch flag per tenant and is tested once in a tabletop.
- [ ] **AC3.** Evaluation report is attached to R3 release notes.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
